models.name: discussion_board_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account recovery. Stores temporary tokens that members can use to reset their passwords when they forget their current password. Each token is associated with a specific member and has a limited validity period.

The system generates a unique token when a member requests password reset and sends it to their registered email address. When the member clicks the reset link with the token, the system validates it and allows password change. After successful password reset, the token is marked as used to prevent reuse.

This table follows the member authentication pattern and maintains referential integrity with the discussion_board_members table through foreign key relationship.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link discussion_board_members.id} requesting password reset.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to member's email.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when password reset token was generated.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when password reset token expires and becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when password reset token was successfully used (null until used).

Each member can have at most one active verification token at a time. Tokens expire after 24 hours and are marked as verified when the member clicks the verification link.

plainFields.name: token

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token expires (always 24 hours after creation).

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null until verification completes.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address where the verification request was made. Used for security auditing.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string from the browser where verification was requested. Used for security auditing.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Updated At.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: discussion_board_admin_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for admin account recovery. Stores unique tokens that admins can use to reset their passwords when forgotten. Each reset request generates a unique token with expiration time and tracks usage for security purposes.

This table supports the admin password recovery workflow by storing:
- Unique reset tokens for authentication
- Token expiration to limit validity period
- Usage tracking to prevent token reuse
- Request metadata for security auditing

Relationships:
- Parent: {@link discussion_board_admins} - admin who requested reset
- Child: {@link discussion_board_admin_sessions} - admin sessions (via admin_id)

Security considerations:
- Tokens are single-use (deleted after use)
- Tokens expire after reasonable time period
- Request metadata helps detect suspicious activity

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin account's {@link discussion_board_admins.id} requesting password reset.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token. Generated cryptographically secure random value. Used to authenticate password reset requests. Single-use token that's invalidated after password change.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration datetime. After this time, the reset token becomes invalid and cannot be used. Standard expiry period: 1 hour from creation.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when this reset token was successfully used. Null until token is consumed for password change. Used for tracking and security auditing.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which password reset was requested. Captured for security auditing and fraud detection purposes.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string from the device requesting password reset. Combined with IP for enhanced security tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Token creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When token is used or expired, it's soft-deleted for audit trail preservation while keeping database clean.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this verification record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail preservation.

models.name: discussion_board_system_logs
models.description:
System audit logs for tracking configuration changes and system events

This table records all significant system events including configuration changes, administrative actions, and important system activities. Each log entry captures the event type, severity level, the actor responsible, affected targets, and before/after values for audit trail purposes.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor who performed the action. Reference to actor table based on actor_type. {@link discussion_board_members.id} when actor_type is 'member', {@link discussion_board_admins.id} when actor_type is 'admin', {@link discussion_board_super_admins.id} when actor_type is 'superAdmin', {@link discussion_board_guests.id} when actor_type is 'guest'.

foreignFields.name: actor_session_id
foreignFields.description: Session context when the action was performed. Reference to session table based on actor_type. {@link discussion_board_member_sessions.id} when actor_type is 'member', {@link discussion_board_admin_sessions.id} when actor_type is 'admin', {@link discussion_board_super_admin_sessions.id} when actor_type is 'superAdmin', {@link discussion_board_guest_sessions.id} when actor_type is 'guest'.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of system event (e.g., 'CONFIG_UPDATE', 'ADMIN_PROMOTION', 'BAN_CREATED', 'DATA_EXPORT'). Standardized event codes for categorization.

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Severity level of the event: 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'. Determines priority and notification requirements.

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: target_id

plainFields.name: old_values

plainFields.name: new_values

models.name: discussion_board_articles
models.description:
Main article entity containing title, content, author reference, and section association. Articles represent the core content of the discussion board and serve as the primary subject for user discussions, comments, and interactions. Each article belongs to a specific section and is authored by a registered user.

This table stores the essential article information including the title, content body, author reference, and section association. Related data such as file attachments, image attachments, and tags are stored in separate tables (discussion_board_article_files, discussion_board_article_images, discussion_board_tags, discussion_board_article_tags) to maintain proper normalization.

The soft delete pattern (deleted_at) is implemented to support content management while preserving historical data for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

- Supports various file types with size tracking
- Implements soft delete pattern for audit trail
